page.overview:
Who is Octopus Devil?

The の|Tako no Akuma}} is a Devil that embodies the concept of octopuses.

The Octopus Devil's full appearance is initially unknown but its head resembles a large and imposing humanoid entity with cephalopod-like features. When summoned by Yoshida on several occasions, it is partially depicted as a mass of giant, oversized tentacles with suckers.

The Octopus Devil's personality is currently unknown.

At some point, Hirofumi Yoshida made a contract with the Octopus Devil for an unknown price.
